219630713.ResearchStatus: Delta container submission-encrypted: no native event table recovered.180 logs/73 IDs audited:17 latest Achieved,1 InProgress,55 NotStarted. Preserved17 achieved recipes; corrected boolean candidates16/78 and added2 map candidates79. No new unlocks verified.
Notes: No Halo 5: Guardians telemetry has been captured. Every event-to-achievement mapping is unverified.

Event names and fields come from the Halo 5 (Ausar) CellEventsSchema in the Halo 5: Forge 1.194.6192.2 dump (build 12719-1, eCellCategory_services.bond, Services_cll subcategory). Guardians runs on the same engine.
Forge captures define the shape conventions used here: integer and bool properties are typed 4, floats go in measurements typed 6, strings and GUIDs are untyped.

Of the 50 Services_cll schema events, 12 (PlayerSessionStart1, PlayerSessionEnd1, PlayerSessionPause1, PlayerSessionResume1, SectionStart1, SectionEnd1, ObjectiveStart1, ObjectiveEnd1, EnemyDefeated1, PlayerDefeated1, PlayerSpawned1, FireteamJoined) are not compiled into Forge PC and are likely Xbox-only. They are candidates if campaign challenge recipes fail.
Package family and SCID are from XboxTitleIDs.json; the Forge app version and !Ausar entry point in the template are borrowed and unverified for Guardians.

Testing values: MissionId 1–15 follows the Halo API campaign missionNumber, DifficultyLevel 0–3 is Easy–Legendary (matches the Forge achievements tag difficulty bitmask), skull CollectibleId 0–12 uses Halo API skull IDs, and CampaignScriptedEvent EventId uses the public achievement ID.
Placeholders: REQ card and pack GUIDs are zero GUIDs and PlatformStatsImpulse impulse names are guesses. Real values are service data not present in the Forge dump or the Halo API metadata.

MultiplayerGameComplete GameCategoryGuid is the Halo API game base variant ID (the Forge-captured 257A305E… is Slayer). ScenarioGuid values are Halo API map IDs, which match the Forge .mapinfo scenario GUIDs.
2026-10-09 Delta container cannot be decrypted with the available keys. No event vocabulary or achievement table is claimed as extracted from it.
180 title-specific logs show17 latest Achieved states and1 InProgress. Existing associated recipes and app envelope are preserved; exact causal attribution of requests is not assumed.

Forge Services_cll Bond schema declares Won and IsMatchmaking as bool. Candidates16/78 now use JSON true and omit the prior integer metadata annotations. Actual retail schema equivalence remains unverified.

Tour of Duty79 has4 populated requirements and2 empty requirements. Two cached-Halo-API map GUID candidates were appended without removing the prior6 requests. Which map corresponds to each requirement GUID is not recovered.
The73 existing reference IDs are corroborated by73 service snapshots. No new CSV was provided for this pass.
No new events were sent during this analysis. HTTP acceptance alone is not achievement credit.

1694054782.ResearchStatus: FM7-invented payload fields removed 2026-10-06; FM6-native events only. Verified against forza_durango_release_final.exe: NumVolumesCompleted/NumShowcasesCompleted/NumCarDivisionsCompleted/NumNascar*/NumPorsche*/BadgeLevel/VisitCount/TotalSpins do NOT exist in FM6 (all fabricated). User-confirmed working unlocks (EquipBadge, Payouts community credits, UGCShares, TombolaSpin, RaceEnd first-race) all fire on the event NAME with payload ignored by the service. CareerResultsUpdate #35-102 now fire proven RaceEnd{Place:1} first, then empty CareerResultsUpdate. Single-completion career races are the likely winners; cumulative 'Complete all X' still need a server-side count no single event can supply. EquipBadge/LinkToHub/TombolaSpin stripped to empty.
Notes: The CSV contains 95 achievements worth 1500 GS. IDs, names, descriptions, and scores are context data from the user attachment.
The executable confirms 49 ETX events. Its descriptors contain event names, schema tags, and field types, but no field names.
A successful template parse is not proof of an Xbox achievement unlock. Service rules and cumulative progress require a genuine capture or rule table.

The previous ForzaResearch/testing-build FM6 block maps several achievements to unrelated events and uses a package/app identity that differs from this dump; this separate block does not overwrite it.
Every supplied achievement is listed for individual testing in the legacy app; FullySupported remains false.
Added event-name-only probes omit custom payload fields. Events requiring those fields may be rejected and should not be interpreted as verified unlock recipes.
A telemetry acceptance response does not establish that the Xbox service achievement condition was met.

2026-10-06: removed fabricated payload fields (BadgeLevel/VisitCount/TotalSpins and the 7 CareerResultsUpdate Num*Completed counters) — none exist in the FM6 exe. Recipes now use FM6-native event names only; CareerResultsUpdate couples a proven RaceEnd first.

The Md#/Hero# -> achievement ALIGNMENT is a POSITIONAL best-guess (CSV order -> Md01..Md22,Hero01..): the dump gives the event names but nothing links a specific Md# to a specific achievement (server-side; no field-name pool, no manifest). Each achievement gets a DISTINCT event so none collide - a single test per achievement will reveal the true alignment and allow a swap. Leftover unused events: Hero02, Hero03 (likely the 3 route/ending 'Hero' events + alternates; achievement IDs 17-20 are absent from the CSV). GameProgress(IGGP, AchievementsEarned_Metric) and AchievementUpdate(IGAU, {CurrentValue,Id=GUID}) also exist as generic drivers but AchievementUpdate needs per-achievement service GUIDs.

1863651407.ResearchStatus: Static, not runtime-tested. 60/60 CSV ids mapped to 60 native EAchievementList values; each value dispatches (PoplarDataPlatform::UnlockAchievement FUN_140fcb580) to its own ETX event (provider TKGB_6F15104F, 0.7.IGB-2.0) whose only custom field is the player's XUID string. Test: fire one recipe and confirm requirements.json current moves.
Notes: Identity: TitleId 0x6F15104F, SCID and AppId PoplarGameShipping from the dump AppxManifest; retail PFN from XboxTitleIDs.json (dump identity is dev 'PoplarGame'). app.id is provisional until a capture confirms it.

Chain: UnlockAchievementDefinition.ApplyUnlock (FUN_141355210, byte AchievementId @+0x138) or native checks -> PoplarPlayerController vfunc+0x2960 (FUN_140cd9eb0) -> +0x2968 (FUN_140d3e780, id 1..61) -> OnlinePlayerInterface+0x1f0 (OnlineSubsystemDurango 0x140bf91c0) -> GEngine+0xba0 DataPlatform vfunc+0x1f8 = FUN_140fcb580 switch(id) -> per-event emitter -> EtxEventWrite(descriptor, TKGB_6F15104F, 3 fields).

Payload: 2 common-field descriptors from EtxFillCommonFields_v7 + 1 UTF-16 string from FUN_140fcbd30 (GetUniquePlayerId formatted %I64u = XUID). Recipes send properties:{} and rely on baseData.userId = REPLACEXUID; mapping that Part C UserId string onto baseData.userId is an application/serialization inference, not recovered from the binary.

Cumulative achievements (Win 30, 5 double kills, 25 titles, all lore, all story) are counted client-side in challenges; the event is sent once at completion. No counter is serialized, so no target value is sent.

Service id 20 ('Dressed for Success', Champion skin) is joined to ACH_UnlockCharacter only by elimination; the dump's own text for that enum is 'Heed the Call - Complete a challenge that unlocks a Battleborn'.
CSV ids 54 and 56 are absent from the CSV; EAchievementList has exactly 60 real values and all 60 are used.
A UserId-in-properties probe is kept in speculative-experiments.json, not here.
